selection_criteria: Current-task fit; control over consequential action; failure recovery; effort and cost.
alternatives: Disable button while pending; idempotent server key; explicit retry reconciliation.
assumptions: Token identity remains stable across retry and the service enforces it.
foreseeable_impacts: Retries may create duplicates if token is changed; pending feedback remains unresolved.
deepening_rationale: The choice changes service state and depends on request identity retry ordering and recovery.
next_coherent_slice: Prove one request through timeout retry reconciliation and observable deduplication before broader build.
followup: Choose and document token lifecycle and recovery behavior; record the test.
